name: Core on screen
description: How the core mod's living things are shown on the interface mod's screens: their reserves as bars in the play screen's status column and on the condition screen, their attributes, and the lines and marks with which blows and powers are played back. A mod of its own, loaded after core and ui, so that core loads without the interface and the interface without core; it reads core's pools and attributes, so a profile that loads it loads core too.
